parameters.query:
SELECT chatwoot_url, chatwoot_token, tool_ativa, config
FROM public.api_n8n_config_tool($1::uuid, 'pagamento');

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.tenant_id, $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.conversation_id ] }}

parameters.body:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  name: $json.descricao,
  description: 'Pedido nº ' + $json.pedido_numero,
  billingType: 'PIX',
  chargeType: 'DETACHED',
  value: Math.round(Number($json.valor_centavos)) / 100,
  endDate: String($json.vence_em).slice(0, 10),
  dueDateLimitDays: 1,
  externalReference: $json.referencia_externa,
  notificationEnabled: false
}) }}

parameters.query: SELECT public.api_n8n_registrar_cobranca($1::uuid, $2::uuid, false, null, null, $3::text) AS registrado;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.tenant_id, $('Reserva Cobranca').first().json.cobranca_id, String($json.error ? ($json.error.message || JSON.stringify($json.error)) : JSON.stringify($json)).slice(0, 500) ] }}
